description_excerpt: Job Description • Support the analysis of laws / regulations and standards of countries worldwide, relevant to product development for Bosch mobility products in several technical topic areas. • Bosch mobility products: automotive and non-automotive products, systems, software, and services. • The technical legal documents cover, but are not limited to, the following areas: vehicle safety, exhaust treatment, On-Board Diagnostics, cybersecurity, materials, data protection, charging, emissions, fuel consumption, energy consumption, EMC (electromagnetic capability), reliability, vibration, and…
